description: This file defines a Serializer object for serializing and deserializing ML parameters, vectors, matrices, and method arguments within Spark's ML connect module. It handles conversion between Scala objects and protobuf representations, supporting Spark MLlib linear algebra types.

methods.name: serializeParam
methods.description: Serializes various data types including vectors, matrices, primitives, and arrays into protobuf literals.

methods.name: buildIntArray
methods.description: Builds a protobuf array literal from an array of integers.

methods.name: buildDoubleArray
methods.description: Builds a protobuf array literal from an array of doubles.

methods.name: deserializeMethodArguments
methods.description: Deserializes method arguments from protobuf representations into Scala objects with associated classes.

methods.name: serializeParams
methods.description: Serializes Spark ML Params objects into protobuf MLParams messages.
